text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the April 2018 Scarborough Community Council agenda, entitled: overnight parking issues on Stonehenge Crescent and Mountland Drive. I would like to move the motion below that would help address the overnight parking issues on Stonehenge Crescent and Mountland Drive where people are illegally parking overnight. Motion: Staff report back to the July 2018 Scarborough Community Council with a report on the feasibility of changing the parking regulations on both sides of Stonehenge Crescent, from Mountland Drive and Stonehenge Crescent (west intersection) to 174 metres further north, and on both sides of Mountland Drive, from Carew Gate to Mornington Gate, to have no parking between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. If you have any questions regarding this matter, please feel free to contact me at 416-392-0204.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services to report back to the July 4, 2018 Scarborough Community Council with a report on the feasibility of changing the parking regulations on both sides of Stonehenge Crescent, from Mountland Drive and Stonehenge Crescent (west intersection) to 174 metres further north, and on both sides of Mountland Drive, from Carew Gate to Mornington Gate, to have no parking between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m.
